label: Actual inquiry: report fibers, distinct belief targets and thin epistemic reasons
summary: Inspected the actual displayed seven distinct research labels and executed the complete pairing with residue 1991. In the eight-prefix finite comparison, the full report nonvacuously and strictly entails odd parity; the pair-only report fails to entail either parity answer yet entails cardinality six or seven. This supplies a different belief content even when the original question remains unsettled, extending the prior hypothetical suspension comparison. The observed data and reproducible Python tests distinguish truth, intelligibility, local validity, correction, evidence-relative merit, normative favoring and preference-independent force. The three structural force assignments vary force while keeping the interpreted evidence fixed; they do not settle actual authority. F1 and thin F6 retain their scope and legacy status. See docs/notes/actual-inquiry-presuppositions.md for exact scope, controls, derivations, commands and handoff. Unlike a report or verdict, that factive evidence-kind cannot be retained in a thoughtless comparison state. The twelve-state structural control and all 2048 actual-containing restrictions passed; 1024 retain the designated deceptive external counterpart. Eight basis-defeat profiles show the separate epistemic uses of one episode: external representational support can be undercut while present-occurrence support survives. Distinct basis labels do not establish that separation, actual acquaintance or independent warrant. The local SurvivingBasisGivesReason calibration remains a substantive application. The weaker present phenomenal existential survives either witness, but the thought-specific bearer consumer 08cef374 cannot accept the broadened Occurs interpretation. Tested 64 two-episode states, 2736 nonempty conditional-probability cases, 1440 accuracy-score comparisons and eight structural reason/force assignments in Python. Every phenomenal primary or challenge witness entails the weak occurrence; report-only and misclassification controls preserve the distinction from thought, actual uptake, and propositionally available evidence. Conditional probability is 1 given the actual witness event of positive mass, and correct acceptance strictly beats incorrect acceptance in the specified score comparison even when suspension ties. Neither fact entails normative force or a subject's warranted recognition of the evidence. The positive local judgment concerns a competent subject actually investigating whether any experience occurs, who grasps the available presented instance's existential bearing. A critic conceding a genuine belief-directed reason for the defeater already grants F6 for another content; withholding alone does not. No concrete rebuttal or lack-of-indicativeness mechanism preserving actual phenomenal presence and competent access has been identified. Higher-order defeat of access and the nihilist's rejection of reason-giving merit remain distinct. No new registered theorem or premise marking. Continuation from d84beef9: instantiated a credible higher-order assessor who challenges recognition of the actual evidence type. Explicit report profiles distinguish retained positive conditional bearing despite a lower joint posterior, neutralization, and reversal. Refining the same reports with actual A/D presentation preserves report marginals but gives probability one to the weak existential when conditioned on actual presentation, including adverse H. Classified zero joint mass and prior saturation separately. A mixed-channel apparent-access model gives strict support from any positive access-capable mode probability and sensitivity when a mode-independent fallback is neutral; an adverse fallback yields an exact threshold, and a dependent-mode control reverses the result even with a neutral fallback. These are stipulated probability comparisons, not a model of actual subjective entitlement. The strongest higher-order internalist can challenge the subject's credential to use a real basis even if actual presence and competent grasp survive; that is distinct from proving non-indicativeness or lack of all pro tanto reasons. Revise the overly broad reading that real occurrence excludes any higher-order defeat. A belief-directed reason for accepting the higher-order defeater or credentialing policy already grants thin F6 for a distinct content; suspension and nonnormative explanation do not. Existing introspection and regress results do not establish a universal credential requirement. current_assessment.scope: Actual inquiry, higher-order defeat of report-level support versus genuinely presented occurrence, partial access, and the local thin F6 judgment.
current_assessment.assessment: Adverse higher-order evidence can lower a joint posterior without eliminating the marker's positive conditional bearing, or can neutralize or reverse it. An actual presented phenomenal instance in the same scope entails the weak existential even under adverse higher-order report information with positive joint mass. It does not thereby establish entitlement to employ that evidence. Under the explicitly mode-independent mixed-channel interpretation a neutral fallback leaves positive support at any positive access-mode probability and sensitivity; an adverse fallback or mode dependence can remove it. The strongest higher-order objection concerns access or a further epistemic credential rather than a negative instance preserving the actual presentation. The ordinary reason judgment for competent inquiry with surviving access remains prima facie warranted, not entailed by information alone. Defeat of sufficient warrant does not entail global reasonlessness. If a critic grants a belief-directed reason for their defeater, thin F6 holds for that different content; the goal-relative account and nonnormative denial remain distinct.
